title: The Rooftop Groove
logline: A shy robot overcomes its stiff programming and finds its rhythm at a lively neon rooftop party.
theme: Overcoming social anxiety and finding joy in self-expression.

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A small, retro-styled robot with expressive LED eyes who is incredibly shy.

characters.name: Spark
characters.one_line_description: A sleek, modern, and charismatic dancer robot covered in glowing neon lines.

scenes.title: Wallflower in the Corner
scenes.summary: Bolt stands alone at the edge of a bustling, neon-lit rooftop party, clutching a oil drink, watching others dance with nervous, flickering eyes.
scenes.setting: Neon-lit futuristic rooftop party at night

scenes.title: The Invitation
scenes.summary: Spark spots Bolt, slides over with smooth, rhythmic steps, and extends a metallic hand, gesturing for Bolt to join the dancefloor.
scenes.setting: Rooftop dancefloor under glowing string lights

scenes.title: Stiff Joints
scenes.summary: Bolt tries to mimic Spark's fluid wave motion but clanks awkwardly, gears grinding. Bolt's screen turns a blushing red, but Spark cheers him on.

scenes.title: Finding the Beat
scenes.summary: Bolt lets go of the fear, starting to bob his head and tap his feet to the bass. His joints loosen as he executes a charming, robotic spin.

scenes.title: The Grand Finale
scenes.summary: Bolt and Spark perform a synchronized pose as the crowd of robots cheers. Bolt's LED eyes light up with bright, happy hearts.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
